args.title: Fix first week missing in weekly scheduled export
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The first week of a weekly scheduled export is not sent if the schedule is created on the same day. This proposed change ensures the first export is sent immediately after the schedule is created, rather than waiting for the next week.
